novelty_note: No candidate may be awarded PROVED - POSSIBLE NOVEL CONTRIBUTION out of this stage. Item 42 forbids awarding it because no identical title was found, and SEARCH_PROTOCOL.md section 0 establishes that title-and-snippet reading is all this stage had. Zero full texts were read. Every source is PARTIAL_SOURCE_ONLY. The ceiling is PROVISIONAL.

claims.statement: Full text could not be obtained for any scholarly source in this environment.
claims.evidence: Direct probe of 15 scholarly hosts, all returning 000 or 403 CONNECT through the egress proxy; WebFetch on arxiv.org returned EGRESS_BLOCKED; the proxy status endpoint logged the connect rejection. Transcript in SEARCH_PROTOCOL.md section 0.
claims.assumptions: The probe reflects the session's actual egress policy and is not a transient failure. Probes were run at the start of the session and the arxiv failure was independently confirmed through two different mechanisms.
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: In this environment, no scholarly full text was reachable; all 90 indexed sources are PARTIAL_SOURCE_ONLY.
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: The literature was reviewed. / The prior art was audited. / We read the closest papers.
claims.next_falsification_test: Re-run the same 15 host probes on a machine with library access; the claim is environment-specific and expected to fail there, which is the point.

claims.evidence: S043, S044 (robust diagnosability against permanent and intermittent loss of observations, Automatica 2012); S047 (dynamic observations); S045 (networked, with delay); S046 (survey); S052 (structural analysis adjusted to a varying measurement set); S049 (2025, diagnosability conditioned on the applied control sequence).

claims.strongest_allowed_wording: The abstract problem candidate C names is a worked, named area with a survey and a 2025 quantitative formulation.
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: Nobody could contribute anything to online diagnosability.
claims.next_falsification_test: Read S049 and S052 in full; if neither conditions diagnosability on realised evidence availability, the kill was too harsh and C reopens.

claims.statement: Candidate A (a monitor determining online whether its own verdict is evidentially supportable) is at very high risk of being closed by existing runtime-verification work.

claims.assumptions: The S016 snippet paraphrase is accurate. It was produced by a search-side model and is not a verbatim quotation.
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: Candidate A is attacked from three directions at once and its PRIOR_ART_RISK is scored 9/10; whether anything survives cannot be determined without full text.
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: S016 solves candidate A. / Candidate A is dead.
claims.next_falsification_test: Read S016, S024 and S041 in full. If none computes per-tick verdict determinacy from the realised observation set, A reopens and may outrank B.

claims.statement: The principle that agreement between channels sharing an upstream source is not evidence of correctness is foundational and cannot be claimed by any candidate here.
claims.evidence: S065 Littlewood and Miller (1989), coincident failures in multiversion software, reached through the secondary paraphrase in S064; common-cause failure theory as described in S066 and S069.
claims.assumptions: The Littlewood-Miller result is correctly characterised in the S064 paraphrase and in general background. The original was not reachable.
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: The principle is at least 37 years old; candidate B may claim only a runtime measurement, never the principle.
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: We show that agreement is not evidence.
claims.next_falsification_test: None needed; this claim constrains rather than supports the selection.

claims.statement: The fusion literature repairs the consistency of a fused ESTIMATE; whether it also reports the lost power of a monitor's diagnostic TEST is not visible at snippet depth.
claims.evidence: S060 (inverse covariance intersection finds and removes a bound on the maximum common information shared by estimates); S061; S062 (data incest); S063 (conditional-independence testing for shared information between fusion inputs).
claims.assumptions: The estimate/test distinction is real and material. A widened covariance does not restore a residual's ability to separate hypotheses - this is argued, not measured.
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: At snippet depth, none of the four closest fusion sources visibly attaches a shared-information verdict to a monitor's diagnostic decision.
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: The fusion literature does not address diagnostic test power. / This is a gap in the fusion literature.
claims.next_falsification_test: Read S063 in full. It is named in SELECTED_CANDIDATE.md as the single most dangerous source; if it crosses the estimate/test line, candidate B dies.

claims.statement: Runtime effective independence of an assurance verdict - a per-verdict, per-tick count of distinct upstream sources derived from source-code provenance - was not visible in any source returned by 36 queries.
claims.assumptions: SINGLE ENGINE, SNIPPET DEPTH ONLY, PATENTS EXCLUDED, AEROSPACE STANDARDS UNREAD. Item 3 forbids using absence from a snippet as evidence of novelty, and this claim does not do so: it records what was not seen, not what does not exist.
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: No source surfaced by this search visibly computes a runtime effective-independence count for a safety monitor's verdict.
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: This is novel. / Nobody has done this. / There is a gap in the literature here.
claims.next_falsification_test: The Stage-0 prior-art gate: read S063, S060, S062, S041 and S016 in full; obtain ARP4761 common-mode analysis; search data-provenance theory and fault-tree minimal cut sets. Any hit kills the candidate.

claims.statement: The proposition underlying candidate B - that a consistency test over channels sharing a single upstream cut vertex has zero power against a fault at that vertex - is a corollary of Menger's theorem and of d-separation.
claims.evidence: SELECTED_CANDIDATE_FORMAL_TARGET.md sections 2 and 3; the equivalence between minimum vertex cut and maximum vertex-disjoint paths is Menger (1927).
claims.assumptions: The provenance graph is a DAG and derivation is functional.
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: The formal content of candidate B is a corollary of classical results and is not a contribution.
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: We prove a new theorem about evidence independence.
claims.next_falsification_test: None. This claim is conceded in advance to hostile Reviewer D and is stated in three separate artifacts so it cannot drift.

claims.statement: The most likely outcome of the Stage-0 experiment is the consequence null H0c: independence deficits occur, are undeclared, and change no assurance action.
claims.evidence: Three consecutive prior CSIA work packages reached an action-level null on their own phenomena: evidence-semantic equivalence (106 ASSURANCE_STATE rows all latency-only, action sets never differed); AI contract synthesis (0 defects promoted from 42 evaluations); semantic authority conflict (0 of 9 authority pairs reached ACTION).
claims.assumptions: That the same downstream insensitivity applies to a structurally different phenomenon. This is a prediction about an experiment that has not been run.
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: Based on three prior action-level nulls on this stack, H0c is the most probable Stage-0 outcome and the design is written so it can win.
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: The experiment will fail. / The effect does not exist.
claims.next_falsification_test: The Stage-0 ACTION endpoint (secondary endpoint S4). This prediction is recorded now so it can be scored later whichever way it goes.

refuted_predictions.prediction: Made at the start of this stage: that at least one of the nine required candidate families would survive prior-art attack on its own terms and could be recommended without qualification.
refuted_predictions.outcome: Refuted. All nine families reduce to an established abstraction that the search surfaced by name. The recommended candidate is a narrowed version of family B, and it is recommended as PROVISIONAL with a mandatory full-text gate, not without qualification.
refuted_predictions.why_kept: The refutation is the main scientific content of this stage and is more informative than the selection.

refuted_predictions.prediction: Made at the start of this stage: that the evidence standard in item 3 could be met, because prior packages had recorded full-text blocking as a limitation rather than as a blocker.
refuted_predictions.outcome: Refuted decisively. Fifteen scholarly hosts were probed and all fifteen were unreachable. Item 3's own fallback (PARTIAL_SOURCE_ONLY) had to be applied to every source without exception, which caps this stage's output at PROVISIONAL.
refuted_predictions.why_kept: This is the reason no novelty claim may be made here, and it must remain visible rather than being softened into a footnote.

refuted_predictions.prediction: Made while scoring: that the top three would separate cleanly under the item-25 weighting.
refuted_predictions.outcome: Refuted. Candidates H and J tied exactly at 3.950, and the disqualified candidate K scored 4.200 - above both. The ranking required a tie-break rule and a disqualification, neither of which the weighted score supplied.
refuted_predictions.why_kept: It shows the weighted score is a prioritisation device and not a discriminating instrument, exactly as item 25 says.
